messages:
Ellie: hey everyone, trying to run the default Buildkite pipeline on my first day and the push step errors with "no basic auth credentials". Which secret should I ask for? Repo is under redwood org and I installed it into my account.

ci-bot: Build #3 failed on step "push-image"
``
+ aws ecr get-login-password --region us-west-2
+ docker login --username AWS --password-stdin 333344445555.dkr.ecr.us-west-2.amazonaws.com
Error response from daemon: login attempt to https://333344445555.dkr.ecr.us-west-2.amazonaws.com/v2/ failed with status: 403 Forbidden
no basic auth credentials
```

jake: welcome! Two quick things: (1) confirm the Buildkite GH App is installed on the repo so org secrets are forwarded, (2) check pipeline envs for AWS_ACCESS_KEY_ID + AWS_SECRET_ACCESS_KEY or confirm the agent IAM role has ECR perms. Also confirm ECR_REGISTRY matches the creds' account.

Ellie: I only had ECR_REGISTRY and AWS_ACCESS_KEY_ID set earlier. I added SECRET now and rebuilt but still 403.

devops-bot: common root cause: creds exist but lack ecr:GetAuthorizationToken or push actions, or registry account mismatch. Try adding a debug step: `aws sts get-caller-identity` to see the principal.

jake: also GH will not forward org secrets to forks or personal copies. If you installed a forked repo, add the org repo or add the repo to the Buildkite app install.

Ellie: ran sts, got `arn:aws:iam::666677778888:user/ellie-onboard`. Looks like the secret maps to an onboarding user but maybe it's missing ecr rights.

devops-bot: added the repo to the Buildkite app and pushed a short-lived pipeline secret `ONBOARD_ECR_TOKEN` for you. Rebuild when ready.

ci-bot: Rebuild started (by Ellie)

ci-bot: Build #4 step "push-image" passed

Ellie: yay! First build green. I'll add a short onboarding note: ensure repo is added to GH app, verify ECR_REGISTRY matches the creds, and either set AWS_ACCESS_KEY_ID/AWS_SECRET_ACCESS_KEY or use an agent IAM role with ECR permissions.

jake: if you want a minimal IAM snippet to paste in the doc, here's what we use for onboarding (scope down for prod):
``
{
  "Version": "2012-10-17",
  "Statement": [{
    "Effect": "Allow",
    "Action": ["ecr:GetAuthorizationToken","ecr:BatchCheckLayerAvailability","ecr:InitiateLayerUpload","ecr:UploadLayerPart","ecr:CompleteLayerUpload","ecr:PutImage"],
    "Resource": "*"
  }]
}
```

Ellie: saved to onboarding.md. Thanks y'all :heart:
